short_term.attribution: Source: Météo-France, modèle AROME-PI (https://portail-api.meteofrance.fr), read by a vigie-meteo gateway; the levels (strong gusts, reduced visibility) and the kinds of precipitation are worked out by Vigie, not an official warning
short_term.note: The forecast of Météo-France's AROME-PI model for the next hours, worked out into levels by this API (the thresholds are in the descriptions of the fields). It is a model forecast, not an official warning: it is never part of local_alert_level, and the warnings of the national services are the nearby_hazards. Each value is the worst of a block of about 4 x 3 km around the point.

probabilities.attribution: Source: Météo-France, prévisions d'ensemble PE-AROME and PE-ARPEGE (https://portail-api.meteofrance.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0), read by a vigie-meteo gateway; the PE-AROME probabilities are Météo-France's, the PE-ARPEGE ones are counted by Vigie among the 35 members; a model forecast, not an official warning
probabilities.note: Probabilities from Météo-France's ensemble forecasts: PE-AROME for the next 51 hours (windows of three hours) and PE-ARPEGE for the next 96 hours (windows of 24 hours), the probability of the block of 5 km or 10 km around the point: a chance for the area, which over-states the chance at one exact spot (measured against ground stations on one morning, ADR 0032). A window's probability is not the probability that it rains at some time of the day. A model forecast, not an official warning: it is never part of local_alert_level, and the warnings of the national services are the nearby_hazards. `rain_probability_pct` of `daily` stays Open-Meteo's (the highest hourly probability of the day, any amount) and is not merged with these: they answer a different question (an amount in a window), so the two numbers can differ.
